payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for predicting implicit and explicit discourse relations, indicating which types the model performs best and worst on.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting explicit discourse relations, with a macro F1-score of 94.17.
The model performs best on the contingency relation, with an improvement of 1.42% in classification performance.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing minority discourse relations, particularly in Comparison and Temporal relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
Implicit discourse relations are predicted with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82, indicating lower performance compared to explicit relations.
